races.name: Betway Handicap

runners_data.name: First Legion
runners_data.note: Hold-up style over 6f with 196 days off and exposed form makes this a tough ask against this field quality
runners_data.comment: Tad exposed, as record of 0-6 since debut success reflects; below par last time
runners_data.spotlight: Good seventh of 19 at the York Ebor festival (6f) in sole handicap attempt but is a tad exposed, as record of 0-6 since debut success reflects; below-par third of four in conditions race on final 2yo start.

runners_data.name: Pilu
runners_data.note: Front-running style with solid course form but 196 days absence and last run was poor in easier company
runners_data.comment: Proved unable to take record to 3-3 and RPRs suggests he's on a stiff mark
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since finishing last of four in Salisbury conditions race when attempting to take record to 3-3; may still have more to offer but RPRs suggest he's facing a stiff task off a mark of 87 in this deep field.

runners_data.name: Song Of The Clyde
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong 6f record and good form figures, well-suited to expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: Largely progressive form includes good performances in two sales races; in the mix
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten favourite in the Two Year Old Trophy at Redcar when last seen but otherwise a progressive sort and may do better still; performed well in sales races at York (won) and Doncaster (close second; form has been strongly franked); capable of playing a big role, even off top weight.

runners_data.name: Silent Applause
runners_data.note: Prominent style but returning from 236 days off and stepping back up to 6f after 5f campaign
runners_data.comment: Has a bit to prove back at 6f but can't be written off; William Buick prefers Treanmor
runners_data.spotlight: Absent since coming up short in Listed grade at York Ebor festival when bidding for 5f hat-trick; return to 6f presents a question mark in this competitive field and William Buick prefers Treanmor; however, cost 1,400,000gns at the Craven breeze-up a year ago and can't be written off.

runners_data.name: Treanmor
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with course and distance win, expensive purchase with class to overcome long absence
runners_data.comment: Impressive over C&D last May and looks interesting back in this scenario on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Cost 2,000,000euros as a yearling and impressively justified favouritism over C&D (good to firm) last May on debut; beaten in three races over 7f/1m since but ran well at Meydan latest; gelded since; interesting with progress possible returned to this scenario on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Advertised
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse yet to win on turf and faces 11lb rise in handicap mark from last decent effort
runners_data.comment: 11lb rise in his mark in this ongoing bid for a first turf win; 2-2 on AW
runners_data.spotlight: Appeared to run well in valuable prize at York (7f) on final 2yo start but an 11lb rise in his mark doesn't help in this ongoing bid for a first turf success; 2-2 on AW, both performances at Newcastle (6f/7f).

runners_data.name: Sovereign Spell
runners_data.note: Front-runner with recent AW win but unproven handicap mark on turf debut for this yard
runners_data.comment: Gained reappearance win in AW maiden that threw up the winner of this contest last year
runners_data.spotlight: Made all for comfortable reappearance success in Wolverhampton maiden (6f, AW) that was won last year by Double Rush, who followed up in this race; mark is unaltered for this second attempt at handicap level; interesting given his good credentials and likelihood of further progress.

runners_data.name: Albaydaa
runners_data.note: Front-running style stepping back to 6f after 7f AW win, likely to improve but faces pace pressure
runners_data.comment: Looks the type to improve further and do well in handicaps for her major connections
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in Wolverhampton maiden (7f, AW) to take her 2yo record to 321; likely to be as effective back down in distance; looks the type to improve further and do well in handicaps for her major connections; attractively weighted near the bottom of the card and is one for the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Boston Dan
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid 6f form but 173 days off and form dipped on final juvenile start
runners_data.comment: Ran well in one of his Listed attempts but has to overcome a difficult mark
runners_data.spotlight: Had an easy task for sole win; good second in sales/Listed races at York, including behind Song Of The Clyde, but form dipped sharply on final 2yo start; has a difficult mark in this first handicap attempt.

runners_data.name: Ironwill
runners_data.note: Front-runner with 6f win on good ground but 205 days absence since completing September double
runners_data.comment: Completed a September double; looks open to further progress this term; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Built on debut effort by completing a September double, showing versatility with the wins over 6f on fast ground and 5f on soft; readily defied a penalty in novice event at Beverley and looks open to further progress this season; possibilities.

runners_data.name: Sir Alfie
runners_data.note: Prominent style with handicap win achieved but now gelded and facing stronger opposition after trainer switch
runners_data.comment: Ex-Irish; 1-1 at handicap level but this looks a stiffer task on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Scored twice during his spell with Ger Lyons, then posted duck eggs in two Listed events for Charles Byrnes; gelded since; 1-1 at handicap level but this looks a tougher task on debut for new stable.

runners_data.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse predominantly on AW this year with headgear applied, tough to assess turf form transfer
runners_data.comment: Returns to turf; chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Reasonably exposed and doesn't look the answer on the balance of his AW form this year; gained his 2yo wins at a lower level; chance largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Reciprocated
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 209 days off and gelded since disappointing in easier nursery
runners_data.comment: Commenced last season with two wins; this reappearance may be the time to catch him
runners_data.spotlight: Absent and gelded since disappointing in Ayr nursery in September when back down in class after defeats at Listed/Group level; commenced last season with two wins over 6f, looking a useful sort, and this reappearance may be the time to catch him; remains of interest.

runners_data.name: Enricher
runners_data.note: Prominent style with recent 6f AW maiden win but stepping up significantly in class for handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Needed a switch to AW to open his account; goes into deeper waters back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Required a switch to AW at Wolverhampton (6f maiden) to open his account at the fourth attempt, and needs further improvement to follow up in this warm handicap back on turf; wears first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Sayidah Hard Spun
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 6f handicap win but only against three rivals and 222 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Raised 4lb for finishing fifth in substandard AW Group 3 but may do better still
runners_data.spotlight: Gained her handicap success at a major track (6f) but against only three rivals and faces a tougher scenario in this deeper field; 4lb rise for final effort (fifth in substandard AW Group 3) adds to the difficulty; on a positive note, there is a chance she can still improve further.

runners_data.name: Lebron Power
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent stats being 3-6 overall and 2-2 over 6f, now 2lb higher than last win
runners_data.comment: Brings good stats, being 3-6 overall, 2-2 in handicaps and 2-2 over 6f; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Brings very good stats, being 3-6 overall, 2-2 in handicaps (both Class 4) and 2-2 over 6f; prevailed narrowly at Newbury (soft) on last appearance; now 2lb higher in a better race but may have further improvement in her; one to consider.

races.paceDynamic: Treanmor, Pilu, Ironwill, and Albaydaa will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this competitive handicap. With four confirmed front-runners over 6f at Newmarket, the pace will be honest throughout and likely fierce in the closing stages. The strong early gallop will stretch the field and create opportunities for those with tactical speed to strike in the final furlong. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with proven tactical pace over pure hold-up horses who need a slow pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If the four leaders go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The honest pace will suit horses like Song Of The Clyde and Silent Applause who can sit just behind the leaders and pounce. Those with proven tactical speed over 6f at this track will have the perfect scenario to strike late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets first run and holds on
scenarios.body: Treanmor's class and course form could see him dictate from the front, while Sovereign Spell showed front-running ability at Wolverhampton. The strong pace may not be fast enough to stop a classy leader with the right tactical ride.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly frantic and collapses
scenarios.body: First Legion and Rogue Supremacy would benefit from a pace meltdown that brings them into contention late. However, with 16 runners the pace is unlikely to be slow enough to significantly favour pure hold-up horses over this sharp 6f trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Moderate Favours Speed
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go steady and save energy for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Lebron Power and Enricher could benefit if the pace becomes more tactical than expected. This would create a dash from the 2f pole where pure speed horses can unleash their finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: Treanmor and Pilu setting fractions too fast early and compromising their chances in the closing stages
Silent Applause and First Legion both returning from 230+ day absences in competitive handicap company
Sovereign Spell's handicap debut on turf after impressive AW maiden win to assess mark accuracy
Song Of The Clyde and Boston Dan both coming back from lengthy breaks but with strong previous 6f form
The four confirmed front-runners creating such a strong pace that it sets up perfectly for prominent runners

races.name: Betway Wood Ditton Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Bemersyde
runners_data.comment: 120,000gns yearling by Ghaiyyath; market may help ahead of this introduction
runners_data.spotlight: 120,000gns yearling by Ghaiyyath; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Warnie (6f-1m including 2yo/Australian Group 2; RPR 115), Montpellier Green (7f 2yo; 81) and Mutaraafeq (1m AW; 79); dam French 9.7f AW winner (including 2yo), half-sister to 1m1f Listed winner On Call Now; respected connections and market may help ahead of this introduction.

runners_data.name: Cosmo Brown
runners_data.comment: 34,000euros foal, 25,000gns yearling; best watched unless the betting suggests otherwise
runners_data.spotlight: By Ghaiyyath; 34,000euros foal, 25,000gns yearling; second foal; half-brother to German 1m2f winner Poyraz Approach; dam unraced sister to useful winners News At Six (1m2f-1m4f) and Leafy Shade (6f 2yo/8.5f); likely best watched on this first go unless the betting suggests otherwise.

runners_data.name: Crown Knott
runners_data.comment: Already-gelded son of Lope De Vega; powerful connections and he's a key contender
runners_data.spotlight: Already-gelded son of Lope De Vega; third foal; half-brother to 5f winner Mc Loven (including 2yo/AW; RPR 88); dam 6f 2yo winner (81), half-sister to winners Blair House (UAE 1m1f Group 1) and Key Victory (1m2f Listed), out of maiden sister to 1m Group 1 winner Poet's Voice; represents powerful connections who have fielded winners of this race before; key contender.

runners_data.name: Impierious
runners_data.comment: By Palace Pier; yard in decent nick but gelding's claims would be aided by market support
runners_data.spotlight: By Palace Pier; tenth foal; closely related to 1m-1m4f winner Mashhoor (including Group 3; RPR 115), half-brother to seven winners including Fambrus (Italian 1m7f Listed; 101) and Faciascura (Italian 1m2f Group 3; 100); dam Italian Group-placed 1m2f/1m3f winner; yard in decent nick but this gelding's claims would be aided by market support.

runners_data.name: Portcullis
runners_data.comment: By Frankel out of French 1,000 Guineas winner; of obvious interest with Ryan Moore booked
runners_data.spotlight: By Frankel; second foal; half-brother to 1m winner Crown Estate (including AW; RPR 100); dam 1m winner (including AW and French 1,000 Guineas; 112), half-sister to 7f Listed winner Top Score, out of unraced sister to this yard's top-class 7f-1m2f winner Raven's Pass; plenty of blue blood in that pedigree and he's one of two for a stable that won this in 2021 and 2022; of obvious interest on this debut with Ryan Moore booked.

runners_data.name: Santushti
runners_data.comment: By Dubawi out of a French Oaks winner; must be considered with Oisin Murphy on board
runners_data.spotlight: Dubawi fifth foal; brother to winners Lord Of Love (1m2f/1m4f; RPR 102) and Governor Of India (1m2f AW; 77); dam 1m-10.5f winner (including 2yo/French Oaks; 109), closely related to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner English Ballet, half-sister to 1m Listed winner King Of Comedy; lots to like about that pedigree and it will be interesting to see what the market makes of him, particularly in relation to his top stable's other contender Portcullis; firmly considered with Oisin Murphy up.

runners_data.name: Take A Chill Pill
runners_data.comment: 65,000gns yearling by Kingman; holds a Derby entry; look for market support
runners_data.spotlight: 65,000gns yearling by Kingman; second foal; half-brother to 1m2f AW winner Star Cast (RPR 71); dam Listed-placed 7f/1m winner (including 2yo/AW; 105), is granddaughter of 11.7f winning sister to 7f Group 3 winner Yalaitanee; the only one of these to hold a big-race entry (The Derby) so look for market support to back that up.

runners_data.name: Me An' All
runners_data.comment: The sole filly and she's best watched without good market support
runners_data.spotlight: Dream Ahead sixth foal; half-sister to four winners including Ventura Gold (7f-1m1f including AW; RPR 79), Chloe's Courage (7f AW; 56) and Kannon (French 5.5f/7.5f); dam 7f AW winner (76), out of 11.7f winning sister to 7f Group 3 winner Yalaitanee; the sole filly and best watched without good market support.

races.name: Zyn Abernant Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: My Mate Alfie
runners_data.note: Prominent runner facing traffic dangers in congested early battle, 19 days since Doncaster pipe-opener suggests fitness edge
runners_data.comment: Group winner in Ireland; seemed to need the run at Doncaster on debut for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding whose good spell in 2024 featured a Group 3 win and who ran creditably a few times last year; seemed to need the run at Doncaster on stable/seasonal debut but has work to do to reverse placings with Aramram and Jasour.

runners_data.name: Time For Sandals
runners_data.note: Prominent type with Commonwealth Cup class but 222-day layoff creates fitness doubt despite Ryan Moore booking
runners_data.comment: Won last year's Commonwealth Cup; subsequent defeats can be excused; leading contender
runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage filly who held on by a neck in last year's Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); had excuses for her subsequent defeats in other major sprints at Goodwood (drop back to 5f; still ran creditably) and Haydock (poorly drawn); has the best chance at the weights.

runners_data.name: Quinault
runners_data.note: Front-running specialist with 12-32 strike rate, proven 6f winner who can press Aspect Island and control tempo
runners_data.comment: Very useful front-runner; unbeaten (4-4) on the Newmarket courses; should make a bold bid
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful front-runner whose strike-rate is 12-32; bagged Group 3 honours at York (7f) last June and a valuable pot at Doha (6f) most recently; unbeaten (4-4) in 6f contests on the Newmarket courses and has shown that he can win in sizeable fields; likely to make a bold bid back here.

runners_data.name: Washington Heights
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up from 5f specialist campaign, faces traffic problems in crowded early positions
runners_data.comment: 5f Listed winner in 2025; produced peak RPR when landing this prize in 2024; not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over 5f last year, bagging Listed honours at York in July prior to facing stiffer tasks returned to Group 1 level; effective at 6f in the past and produced his peak RPR when landing this prize (on good ground) in 2024; not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Crestofdistinction
runners_data.note: Prominent type with poor turf record (0-5) compared to AW form, 200-day break adds fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Posted peak RPR on turf but needs an even bigger effort to gain first win in this sphere
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 0-5 on turf compared to 2-3 on AW; admittedly registered his peak RPR in this sphere when second Elmonjed in York Listed contest (6f) on penultimate appearance; however, needs an even bigger effort to go one better in this field.

runners_data.name: Beckford's Folly
runners_data.note: Prominent 3yo with perfect 3-3 Newmarket record, William Buick's tactical nous crucial in traffic
runners_data.comment: Gelded prior to Cornwallis win, taking record on the Newmarket tracks to 3-3; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Gelded prior to prevailing narrowly in the Cornwallis (5f, good; Group 3) on final 2yo start, taking record on the Newmarket tracks to 3-3; effective over 6f and looks open to further improvement; carries 3lb penalty; respected kept to this venue in first attempt against his elders.

runners_data.name: Diligent Harry
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better on AW recently, tactical style suits expected pace collapse scenario perfectly
runners_data.comment: Good strike-rate on AW includes a Lingfield Listed double this year; 0-18 on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Good strike-rate on AW includes a Listed sprint double at Lingfield this year, sharing the spoils with Completely Random on reappearance; similar to that rival, looks far from guaranteed to maintain the form back on turf; 0-18 in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Elmonjed
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with strong York form, 221-day break offset by William Haggas' ability to get them ready
runners_data.comment: Recorded last three wins at York and may be more interesting when back there
runners_data.spotlight: Has form on the Newmarket tracks but recorded last three wins at York, including when beating Crestofdistinction with more in hand than the narrow margin suggests in Listed grade on most recent appearance; likely to be more interesting when back at that venue.

runners_data.name: Jasour
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up runner whose style perfectly suits the expected prominent congestion and traffic problems ahead
runners_data.comment: Very useful and has Group 1 form; solid effort behind Aramram at Doncaster on reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful 6f performer who registered last success in Group 3 contest at Ascot two years ago; has Group 1 form, including creditable sixth in the 2025 July Cup; made a solid start to his 2026 campaign with 1l second to Aramram at Doncaster; again likely to be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: Aramram
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse progressing through handicaps, beat Jasour last time and tactical style suits pace set-up
runners_data.comment: Steadily progressive; won by 1l going away from Jasour at Doncaster on seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Steadily progressive, mostly in handicaps, throughout his career; won by 1l going away from Jasour in Listed event at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) on seasonal debut, looking better than ever and taking record to 6-23; solid second in both C&D starts; enters calculations upped further in grade.

runners_data.name: Aspect Island
runners_data.note: Sole front runner with uncontested lead, 167-day break concern but Luke Morris can dictate ideal fractions
runners_data.comment: Good third in the Cornwallis and Breeders' Cup race; 1-1 over 6f; could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Proved well ahead of his mark in sole handicap attempt and only start over 6f, then finished a good third in the Cornwallis (behind Beckford's Folly) and the Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf Sprint; receives weight all round and could go well.

runners_data.name: Run To Freedom
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran making fourth Abernant attempt, age concerns and long absence work against him
runners_data.comment: Capable of smart form but seems unlikely to break his Abernant duck at the fourth attempt
runners_data.spotlight: Capable of smart form, such as placed efforts in two July Cups, but is getting long in the tooth and seems unlikely to break his Abernant duck at the fourth attempt (record in this race reads 404); losing spell goes back almost three years.

runners_data.name: Completely Random
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner better on AW with 4-8 record there, 75-day gap and turf form questions remain
runners_data.comment: Dead-heated with Diligent Harry in Listed race, taking AW record to 4-8; just 1-9 on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Dead-heated with Diligent Harry in Listed grade to complete a Lingfield 6f double in January and take AW record to 4-8; effective when fresh but is by no means certain to transfer the improvement back to turf; only 1-9 in this sphere; tongue-tie applied.

runners_data.name: Prince Of India
runners_data.note: Prominent type coming off disappointing AW favourite defeat, needs ideal ground conditions to show best
runners_data.comment: Has form figures of 12113 on good/firmer; interesting provided he gets similar ground
runners_data.spotlight: Only fifth when favourite for AW event on reappearance but is reasonably interesting back on turf, provided he gets ideal ground; has form figures of 12113 on good/firmer, the final effort in Listed grade behind Elmonjed; may still have more to offer.

races.paceDynamic: Aspect Island is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms without early pressure, setting a sustainable tempo. Behind him, six runners (My Mate Alfie, Time For Sandals, Quinault, Washington Heights, Crestofdistinction, Beckford's Folly) all want prominent positions, creating significant congestion and traffic problems from 2f out. The hold-up brigade led by Diligent Harry, Elmonjed, Jasour and Aramram will benefit from this set-up, as the prominent pack will compromise each other while the patient riders get clear runs. This pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up horses who can weave through traffic and time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack creates the expected traffic jam 2f out
scenarios.body: The six runners fighting for early positions will compromise each other's momentum while Aspect Island sets modest fractions. Patient hold-up runners like Aramram, Elmonjed and Diligent Harry get dream runs through gaps to sweep past the stalled leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Quinault Controls Early
scenarios.trigger: If Quinault uses his front-running ability to press Aspect Island and dictate stronger fractions
scenarios.body: The 12-32 strike rate specialist forces a genuine gallop that spreads the field and reduces traffic problems. His proven 6f effectiveness at this level gives him the edge over tiring hold-up horses who face a stiffer test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Aspect Island Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Aspect Island's uncontested lead proves insurmountable with patient Luke Morris timing
scenarios.body: The 3yo gets perfect fractions up front while the prominent congestion behind allows him to maintain his advantage. His third in the Cornwallis behind Beckford's Folly shows he has the class when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Time For Sandals Class
scenarios.trigger: If Ryan Moore can secure an ideal stalking position without getting caught in the prominent traffic
scenarios.body: The Commonwealth Cup winner's low-mileage profile and 222-day break work in her favour as she avoids the pace problems. Moore's tactical brilliance gets her into contention at the right moment to use superior class.

watchPoints.text: My Mate Alfie, Washington Heights, Crestofdistinction and Beckford's Folly will create a four-way battle for prominent positions behind Quinault, causing major traffic problems
Time For Sandals needs Ryan Moore to avoid the early prominent congestion while overcoming 222 days off the track
Aspect Island's 167-day layoff could see him tire if Quinault or others force genuine early fractions
Diligent Harry and Completely Random both prefer AW surfaces but tactical hold-up styles suit this pace scenario
Aramram's progressive profile through handicaps gets stern Listed/Group test but hold-up style is perfectly suited

races.name: Betway Craven Stakes (Group 3) (Colts & Geldings)

runners_data.name: Hidden Force
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 50 days off with only AW experience but unbeaten record suggests significant ability
runners_data.comment: Two from two, namely AW wins at Kempton, latest in a notable conditions race; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel colt who is two from two, namely AW wins at Kempton, last time comfortably beating Venetian Prince in 1m conditions race that his yard landed in 2024 and 2025 with subsequent Group 1 scorers (including 2,000 Guineas); the signs look very good for this highly promising sort.

runners_data.name: Avicenna
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after long 216-day break but perfect record on good ground makes him dangerous
runners_data.comment: Two from two, both starts at Doncaster; collared Hankelow in Listed grade latest
runners_data.spotlight: Two from two last year, both starts over 7f at Doncaster, latest in Listed grade (on good ground) when collaring Hankelow on the line despite still seeming green; may have plenty of further progress in him, especially over this extra furlong; one of the main players.

runners_data.name: Hankelow
runners_data.note: Prominent style with excellent course record and only loss came when nabbed on the line by Avicenna
runners_data.comment: Made all in Group 3 over C&D on last appearance; progressive and has solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Night Of Thunder colt who nearly went 3-3 last season, the sole defeat when nabbed by Avicenna on the line at Doncaster; justified favouritism in the Autumn Stakes over C&D (good to firm; Group 3) next time, making all; progressive and holds solid claims.

runners_data.name: Hawk Mountain
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who made all in Group 1 Futurity but may need softer ground than this good surface
runners_data.comment: Made all in the Futurity to complete a 1m hat-trick; improving colt who is the form pick
runners_data.spotlight: Made all and did enough to beat two stablemates in the Futurity at Doncaster (heavy; Group 1) to complete a 1m hat-trick and take record to 3-4; may ideally need further this year, especially when the ground isn't testing; otherwise the form pick and an improving Ballydoyle colt to boot.

runners_data.name: Oxagon
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who was clearly unsuited by heavy ground last time and returns to more suitable conditions
runners_data.comment: Chance of opening his Group account depends on the effects of first-time headgear
runners_data.spotlight: Unsuited by heavy ground in the Futurity on final 2yo start; steadily progressive otherwise, and ran well in the Champagne Stakes at Doncaster and Dewhurst at Newmarket; however, chance of opening his Group account largely depends on the effects of first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Venetian Prince
runners_data.note: Front-runner who was well beaten by Hidden Force recently and needs to find significant improvement
runners_data.comment: Unlikely to reverse Kempton placings with Hidden Force but again could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Newbury when last seen on turf; looked flattered to finished just under 2l behind Hidden Force, who had something in hand, at Kempton most recently and is unlikely to reverse the placings; however, bred to do better still and may produce another good effort.

runners_data.name: Commander's Intent
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent record but seems to have hit his ceiling as a handicap performer
runners_data.comment: His ceiling is seemingly already known and he doesn't have a Guineas entry
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 2-7 and broadly consistent last term; creditable second in last three starts, including in 7f Group 3 at Newmarket; however, his ceiling is seemingly already known and, unlike all of today's rivals, he doesn't have a 2,000 Guineas entry.

races.paceDynamic: Hawk Mountain and Venetian Prince are the two confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Hawk Mountain's proven ability to make all giving him the edge in the battle. With only seven runners, the pace won't be breakneck but will be honest enough with these two ensuring no dawdling. Avicenna, Hankelow, Oxagon and Commander's Intent will track in behind, while Hidden Force is the sole hold-up horse who needs them to go fast enough. This honest gallop over Newmarket's flat mile clearly favours the prominent racers who can position close enough to strike without getting embroiled in the early pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go fast enough early but tire in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The honest pace sets it up perfectly for the quartet tracking behind to come through and fight out the finish. Horses like Avicenna, Hankelow and Oxagon are ideally positioned to capitalize without having done the donkey work.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Hawk Mountain gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: His proven ability to make all at this trip combines with tactical superiority to see off all challengers. Venetian Prince may chase him home if he settles better than usual behind the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough to set up Hidden Force's closing kick
scenarios.body: The Frankel colt gets the strong gallop he needs and sweeps past tiring leaders with his superior class telling. His two impressive AW wins suggest he has more improvement in him than most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means it becomes a messy sprint where any horse can win on the day. The more experienced campaigners like Oxagon and Commander's Intent could benefit from their racecourse knowledge.

watchPoints.text: Hawk Mountain could get an uncontested lead if Venetian Prince doesn't go with him early which would make him very hard to catch
Hidden Force needs the pace to be strong enough to set up his finishing kick or he could be caught flat-footed
Avicenna returns after 216 days off but his trainer Roger Varian has a decent strike rate with his runners
The small field of seven could lead to a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight
Oxagon drops back to more suitable good ground after his heavy ground flop in the Futurity last time

runners_data.name: Eloquencia
runners_data.comment: 52,000gns yearling by Sea The Stars; market might help ahead of this debut
runners_data.spotlight: 52,000gns yearling by Sea The Stars; twelfth foal; half-sister to seven winners including Pimento (Group-placed 1m AW including 2yo; RPR 112), White Bullet (6f AW; 87), Zakreet (7f/1m 2yo; 86) and Valkyrja (1m; 71); dam unraced sister to 11.4f Listed winner Birdie; market might help ahead of this debut.

runners_data.name: La Mariposa
runners_data.comment: By Zoustar; dam 7f/1m winner (93); unlikely newcomer but market check advised
runners_data.spotlight: By Zoustar; half-sister to 6f AW winner Lord Danielson (RPR 57); dam 7f/1m winner (including AW; 93), sister to UAE 1m winner Pictograph, out of unraced half-sister to 1m2f-1m4f Group 1 winner Vengeance Of Rain; stable not a noted source of winning newcomers but worth a market check.

runners_data.name: Thursday Girl
runners_data.comment: 240,000gns foal by Pinatubo; raw when fifth on sole start last year; better on the cards
runners_data.spotlight: 240,000gns foal by Pinatubo; looked raw but plugged on late when fifth of nine in Salisbury maiden (7f, good) in October; yard among the winners and she's surely capable of better.

runners_data.name: Hassaleh
runners_data.comment: Night Of Thunder filly; 3rd in 6f Windsor fillies' novice (good) in June; player on return
runners_data.spotlight: Night Of Thunder filly; dam 6f and 7f (Group 2) 2yo winner/1,000 Guineas second (116); 13-2 when encouraging third of nine in 6f Windsor fillies' novice (good) in June; not seen since but almost certainly has best days ahead of her and any market confidence could prove telling.

runners_data.name: Baandee
runners_data.comment: Runner-up all three starts (7f, AW) and she sets the standard; turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in three starts, all over this trip at Chelmsford (AW); doesn't look to be doing anything wrong in a finish and sets the standard on form; contender again with nothing in her pedigree suggesting this switch to turf will be a problem.

races.name: Betway EBF "Confined" Novice Stakes (For horses Which Have Run No More Than Once) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Birgham Dub
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 271-day break faces strong early pace that could ideally set up his closing kick.
runners_data.comment: Green when winning narrowly from out the back in a maiden at Haydock (7f, good) last July
runners_data.spotlight: 240,000euros yearling; by Sea The Moon out of a close relation to 1m2f Group 1 winner Sultanina; second favourite for seven-runner maiden at Haydock (7f, good) last July, which he nearly blew when making an awkward start and first off the bridle but he came from the back and stuck his neck out well for a narrow win; absent since but should be open to major improvement.

runners_data.name: Amadeus Mozart
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven 7f form steps up in trip for powerful Ballydoyle team showing good recent form.
runners_data.comment: 10-11, won Curragh maiden (7f, good) last June in a five-way scrap; Dante and Derby entry
runners_data.spotlight: By Wootton Bassett out of a Galileo mare; 10-11 for maiden at the Curragh (7f, good) last June and always prominent to win that ten-runner race by half a length in a five-way scrap, but he has not raced since; stablemate in second was useful afterwards but the third showed no better than fair form; a promising Dante and Derby entry, for whom the market may guide.

runners_data.name: Maho Bay
runners_data.note: Natural front runner from in-form Appleby stable returns from 120-day break with fitness question over longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Kempton win (1m3f, AW; 5-6) in December came with great authority; Dante and Derby entry
runners_data.spotlight: By Dubawi; third foal; half-brother to winners Cavallo Bay (Group-placed 7f 2yo; RPR 101) and Spring Beauty (French 5.5f); dam 6f/1m 2yo winner (including Canadian turf Grade 1; 106); 5-6 for five-runner maiden at Kempton (1m3f, AW) in December, leading 2f out for a 6l win; that came with great authority, so this Dante and Derby entry looks a good prospect.

runners_data.name: Galiyan
runners_data.note: Unraced newcomer with unknown tactics but strong breeding makes debut assessment difficult for punters.
runners_data.comment: 180,000gns yearling by Galiway; Dante entry, so needs a close look despite debut
runners_data.spotlight: 180,000gns yearling by Galiway; fifth foal; closely related to 1m1f-1m2f winner Integrant (including AW Listed; RPR 108), half-brother to French 9.5f winner Viatore; dam Group-placed 7f/1m 2yo winner (103), half-sister to Group 3 winners at 7f and 1m; trainer won this last year with another Dante (and Derby) entry and this debutant needs a close look.

runners_data.name: Guildmaster
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader from Gosden yard returns after 115-day absence with potential fitness concerns over staying trip.
runners_data.comment: Fav, 3l win at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December despite looking green; Dante and Derby entry
runners_data.spotlight: 325,000gns yearling by Teofilo; ninth foal; brother to four winners including Group winners Guaranteed (RPR 109) and Gear Up (114); 13-8 favourite for novice at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December and came from fifth of 12 at halfway to win by  3l, despite looking green; Dante and Derby entry from a top yard, who'll surely stay and find plenty of improvement this term.

runners_data.name: Sir Griflet
runners_data.note: Recent poor form and low rating make him outclassed despite prominent running style suiting race shape.
runners_data.comment: 46l defeat at Southwell (1m3f, AW; 14-1) five days ago suggests he faces a very stiff task
runners_data.spotlight: Camelot half-brother to five winners, notably Bolshoi Ballet (1m-1m4f including US Grade 1; RPR 119); 46l defeat at Southwell (1m3f, AW; 14-1) five days ago suggests he faces a very stiff task.

races.paceDynamic: Maho Bay and Guildmaster, both confirmed front runners, will clash from the gates creating an honest early gallop over this stamina-testing 1m2f trip at Newmarket. With only six runners and two natural leaders, the pace will be solid but not suicidal, allowing the race to develop into a proper staying test in the final three furlongs. Amadeus Mozart and Sir Griflet will sit in behind the leaders, while Birgham Dub will be held up at the rear with Galiyan's tactics unknown on debut. This race shape clearly favours horses with proven stamina and the ability to sustain their effort, benefiting those who can either lead throughout or make their move from prominent positions rather than hold-up horses facing a potentially testing gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Maho Bay or Guildmaster gets an uncontested lead after early skirmishing
scenarios.body: The winner dictates ideal fractions and kicks clear in the straight, with the second front runner potentially holding on for place money. Superior class tells when allowed to utilize natural pace advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders go too hard early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: Amadeus Mozart benefits most from his handy position behind the pace, timing his run perfectly as the leaders weaken. His proven ability at this trip gives him the edge over other closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favours Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Maho Bay and Guildmaster engage in a prolonged speed duel from the start
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for Birgham Dub's hold-up style, allowing Rossa Ryan to produce him with a sweeping late run. The collapse of both leaders opens the door for the best stayer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Debut Winner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If Galiyan shows natural ability and avoids early trouble despite debut inexperience
scenarios.body: The Andrew Balding newcomer benefits from a solid pace that doesn't expose his lack of experience, with Oisin Murphy finding the right position. Superior breeding and freshness overcome racecourse naivety.

watchPoints.text: Maho Bay and Guildmaster could compromise each other if they engage in early speed battle rather than one yielding.
Galiyan's debut tactics remain completely unknown with Oisin Murphy aboard, creating potential pace disruption.
Birgham Dub's 271-day absence may tell against him despite the race shape potentially suiting his hold-up style.
Amadeus Mozart stepping up significantly in trip from 7f debut win could find 1m2f beyond current scope.
Sir Griflet's recent 46-length defeat suggests he lacks the class to compete with these higher-rated opponents.

races.name: Watch Live Racing At Betway Handicap

runners_data.name: Percy's Lad
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with proven course form who should get ideal position tracking Goldmoyne
runners_data.comment: Absent 20 months but h'capper has given him a shot and yard going well; watch the market
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in this race in 2024 when it was staged as a Class 2; made all at Chester (7.5f, good to firm) on his next start and it was a solid fourth back there (7f, good to soft) when last seen 20 months ago; yard going well and handicapper has given him a shot too; watch the market.

runners_data.name: Dragon Leader
runners_data.note: Early pace likely but may lack the class edge despite returning to better trip
runners_data.comment: Good 2yo and latest third was encouraging; suspicion he could be on the way back
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to match his 2yo best (included big sales race and Listed wins) but he's only had eight subsequent starts and latest third at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) four weeks ago was a firm step back in the right direction; same mark and there's a suspicion he could be on the way back; player if so.

runners_data.name: Jordan Electrics
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces significant traffic concerns with 620 days off
runners_data.comment: Admirable old boy but no win last year and return was poor; tries 7f for the first time
runners_data.spotlight: Admirable old boy who had a sparkling 2024, winning seven times (5f/6f, sound surface) mostly at Hamilton; couldn't add to that haul last year, though, and never figured when last on his recent reappearance (soft ground admittedly against him); tries 7f for the first time on this 84th start.

runners_data.name: Jumby
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from long break with traffic worries in big field
runners_data.comment: Hard to ignore his last win came back in June 2023 (7f G3) but returns on reduced mark
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner who could only beat one home in this race when it was staged as a Class 2 last year; managed a handful of creditable efforts subsequently but it's hard to ignore his last win came back in June 2023 (7f Group 3); returns on reduced mark.

runners_data.name: Havana Pusey
runners_data.note: Prominent type but 200 days absence is concerning for sharpness
runners_data.comment: Needs to be near best to make a winning comeback but beaten a nose on last year's return
runners_data.spotlight: Progressed last term; pick of her efforts came when fourth in AW Group 3 (6f) in June and when beating all bar Royal Velvet in July course handicap (7f, good to firm) the following month; will need to be near her best to make a winning seasonal debut but was beaten only a nose on last year's return.

runners_data.name: Sujet
runners_data.note: Likely to race prominently but carries a 3lb penalty from claiming rider
runners_data.comment: Won twice for Dermot Weld; left that yard for 150,000gns; first try at 7f and unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Won at the Curragh (1m1f) on seasonal/handicap debut in June and doubled his tally in Killarney conditions event (1m, also good) in August; big disappointment on final start for Dermot Weld in late September but new connections had to go to 150,000gns to secure him one month later; unexposed and interesting to see how he goes in the market ahead of this first start at 7f.

runners_data.name: God Of War
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent form but needs significant luck in running

runners_data.name: Bold Impact
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in class after long absence
runners_data.comment: Weak in the market for his stable debut when it all went wrong at the start 19 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: First-time blinkers when making all for easy win in Epsom novice (7f, soft) in September 2024; encouraging return from a year's absence the following October but he left Ralph Beckett after a moderate effort next time; weak in the market for his stable debut when it all went wrong at the start 19 days ago.

runners_data.name: Physique
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but new headgear questions after 18-day break
runners_data.comment: Big Galway handicap win for this trainer in 2024; might step forward from recent comeback
runners_data.spotlight: C&D novice winner back in the day and he was trained by Micky Fenton in Ireland when landing big Galway handicap (7f, heavy) in 2024; back with his former trainer (in Newmarket this time) when weakening over 6f at Doncaster 18 days ago; might step forward from that comeback.

runners_data.name: Crimson Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse well above last winning mark and rusty from 184-day break
runners_data.comment: Started last term well; above last winning mark but can feature if returning in same vein
runners_data.spotlight: Started last term very well; third of 21 at York (good) in May followed by hat-trick of wins (also 7f, good to firm) across June and July; remains 4lb above his last winning mark but could feature if returning in similar vein.

runners_data.name: Royal Velvet
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse with course form but faces major traffic problems
runners_data.comment: Steady improver who scored three times last year; should be ready and she's much respected
runners_data.spotlight: Steady improver who scored three times last year, including here (1m) in May and on the July course (7f, also good to firm) two months later; also landed valuable big-field fillies' handicap at York which bodes well for this test; should be ready to roll on this return and she's much respected.

runners_data.name: Morte Point
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with tactical speed advantage
runners_data.comment: 3-4 since asked to tackle 7f; big fields no problem; can likely do better again this term
runners_data.spotlight: 3-4 since asked to tackle 7f from late August with wins at Newbury (good) and twice on AW (latterly dead-heating); big fields no problem and he can likely do better again this term; player if tuned up.

runners_data.name: Huscal
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but gelded and showing improved consistency over this trip
runners_data.comment: Went close three times at 7f last term; returns on a competitive-looking mark
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins as a juvenile (6f, good/good to firm); couldn't add to that tally last year but he was gelded in May and went close three times at 7f (good to firm/AW) subsequently; returns on a competitive-looking mark and he's considered.

runners_data.name: Eminency
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with new tongue-tie stepping up significantly in class
runners_data.comment: Respectable on both starts last month and Oisin Murphy takes over for the first time
runners_data.spotlight: Kept fairly busy in the last 12 months and he supplemented a 6f Windsor (good) win in September by scoring over 7f at Yarmouth (good to soft) in October and at Chelmsford (AW) in December; respectable efforts on both starts last month and Oisin Murphy takes over for the first time.

runners_data.name: Storm Free
runners_data.note: Strong closer returning from 184-day break with fitness concerns
runners_data.comment: Won in big field; plenty of potential ahead of this comeback on just fourth handicap start
runners_data.spotlight: Good-ground maiden winner on his April return last year and it was a good run after a break when third of 14 at Newcastle (also 6f, AW) in August; signed off by beating 14 others at Leicester (7f, good) in October after which he was gelded; retains plenty of potential ahead of this comeback on just his fourth handicap start.

runners_data.name: Goldmoyne
runners_data.note: Only confirmed leader wearing cheekpieces with excellent recent AW form
runners_data.comment: Prolific on AW for new yard and two wins in Ireland came in big fields on a sound surface
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who has been productive on AW in cheekpieces this winter for James Owen; went back-to-back at Newcastle (6f) in December and secured a four-timer when scoring at Lingfield (1m; first three legs at 7f) last month; creditable third back on turf (7f, good to soft) last time and his two wins on turf in Ireland came in big fields on a sound surface; considered.

runners_data.name: Gangsta Man
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in blinkers but faces significant class rise
runners_data.comment: Dual 7f winner; big effort over 5f on recent stable debut; has to be of interest
runners_data.spotlight: Dual 7f (good/good to yielding) winner in Ireland who was soon outpaced before coming home strongly to be beaten a whisker in 5f Scottish Sprint Cup (soft) 12 days ago; that was a really encouraging first go for Jim Goldie and this step back up to 7f should be fine; has to be of interest.

runners_data.name: Dapper Guest
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in visor returning from 134-day absence
runners_data.comment: Improved in headgear over 7f last term (three wins); not ruled out on this reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Improved in headgear over 7f last term, winning in first-time cheekpieces on the July course (good to firm) in June and in a newly fitted visor at Southwell in August; also scored in latter aid at Chelmsford (also AW) in October; slight worry slow starts were a feature of his last two runs but might have needed a rest by then; not ruled out on this reappearance.

races.paceDynamic: Goldmoyne is the only confirmed front runner in this 18-runner handicap and should get an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Dragon Leader, Percy's Lad, Morte Point and Bold Impact likely to settle just behind rather than challenge early. The large field of hold-up horses including Royal Velvet, Storm Free, God Of War and Jordan Electrics will create significant traffic problems in the straight as they all look for racing room simultaneously. With one leader setting sustainable fractions and a mass of closers needing luck in running, this race strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and avoid the inevitable scrimmaging behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Goldmoyne Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Goldmoyne gets soft fractions and kicks clear turning for home...
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the hold-up brigade get in each other's way in a bunched finish. Prominent trackers like Percy's Lad and Morte Point are best placed to chase home the winner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace-tracking horses coordinate to reel in Goldmoyne in the final furlong...
scenarios.body: The early positioned runners have first run on the leader while the back markers are still organising their challenges. This becomes a battle between those who showed early tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gaps
scenarios.trigger: If one of the closers gets a dream run through traffic while others get blocked...
scenarios.body: A single hold-up runner with superior class exploits clear sailing while their rivals are still shuffling for room. The winner comes from the back but needed everything to fall perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with multiple fallers or severe interference...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning and luck determining the outcome more than form. Any horse finding daylight in the final 100 yards can capitalise on the mayhem.

watchPoints.text: Goldmoyne must be monitored early as the only front runner could get an uncontested lead
Traffic problems developing from 2f out as 14 hold-up horses converge simultaneously
Royal Velvet and Storm Free returning from 6+ month breaks may need the run
Morte Point's tactical speed could be crucial if he can sit closer than usual
Percy's Lad's proven course form gives him a significant edge over prominent rivals
